description: Move dashboard status, inspection, character, event, and display-assignment assembly out of DashboardLive into one read-only snapshot or presenter module. Preserve safe failure handling and the three-second refresh behavior. Keep LiveView lifecycle, events, and rendering unchanged in this issue. Acceptance: DashboardLive no longer owns data-source orchestration; snapshot tests cover healthy and unavailable dependencies; existing dashboard tests pass.
title: Extract dashboard snapshot assembly
